[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Sawyer Merritt (@SawyerMerritt); megjelent: 2026-10-26T12:47:41+00:00; link: https://x.com/SawyerMerritt/status/2114700495130354030; média: 1 kép]
Tesla FSD Supervised (now named Tesla Assisted Driving in Europe) has officially been approved in Latvia, marking the 10th European country.

Countries in Europe that have approved it so far:
• Belgium
• Netherlands
• Denmark
• Lithuania
• Estonia
• Slovenia
• Czechia
• Croatia
• Slovakia
• Latvia
